chunks: that the abode of migration (Medina) has been vacated by its residents and they have abandoned it. It is boiling like a huge cooking pot and rebellion is fixed on its axis moving with full force. So, hasten towards your amīr (commander) and proceed forward to fight your enemy, if so wills Allāh to Whom belongs Might and Majesty.

key_terms.جَيْشَ الْمِرْجَلِ: Boiling like a huge cooking pot (metaphor for turmoil)

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the 'abode of migration' being vacated in Imam Ali's letter to Kufa?
ai.summary: In this address to the Kufans, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) uses the metaphor of a boiling cauldron to describe the intense turmoil and fitna that has taken root in Medina, signaling the end of its stability. He urges them to hasten to his leadership and engage in jihad, emphasizing the urgency of consolidating the Muslim community against internal and external enemies during this critical transitional period.
